bounds.domain: Seven mandatory PR lanes. Each settles once to success, failure, cancellation or skipped. One aggregate evaluation follows all terminal results.
bounds.assumptions: GitHub dependency scheduling prevents the aggregate from running before all needs settle. The hook reads the actual YAML dependency/result lists and executes the actual shell gate for all 29 one-fault outcomes.
bounds.limitations: The model does not prove GitHub service availability, job contents, branch-rule deployment, administrator bypass policy, or arbitrary changes to the set of mandatory lanes. Workflow cancellation that stops the aggregate itself remains a non-success outcome.

assumptions: Weak fairness settles every running mandatory lane and evaluates the enabled aggregate. No particular successful outcome is assumed.
No fairness or service availability is assumed. A permanently running lane can prevent the aggregate from completing.
